### Bio

I’m an associate professor of political science at [The University of California, Davis](https://ps.ucdavis.edu/) where I [research](/research.html) and [teach](/teaching.html) on security, development, and research methods. I also co-lead the [CPLAB](https://ucd-cplab.netlify.app/) with [Lauren Young](https://laurenelyssayoung.com/). I often partner with governments, international donors, and their implementing partners to improve how development programs are designed and evaluated.

I was born in Cali, Colombia, grew up between there and South Florida, and have since lived in Texas, North Carolina, South Carolina, and now California.
